description: ping -s 4000 127.0.0.1 on lo and ping -s 8000 on a jumbo-frame LAN, three each: standard payloads in single frames. Only the low oversized Echo Request rule fires. ping -s 1472 fills a 1500-byte frame exactly and does not. (A fragmented large ping is not reassembled, and its first fragment carries at most 1472 bytes; see legit_large_ping.)
